note: What a server sends to change something about a prop already on the map. The kind of change is named inside it, and the fields around the kind keep one layout whatever it is. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: name
fields.note: A name: an animation's, a particle's or a look's, by the change below. The name ends at its first zero byte; the bytes after it carry no meaning.

fields.name: first
fields.note: For animate, when the animation starts, in seconds of match time.

fields.name: second
fields.note: For animate, how long the animation runs, in seconds.

fields.name: value
fields.note: A value the change uses: for animate, the animation's flags; for linkEffect, the particle effect value; for look, the look's number.

fields.name: change
fields.note: What changes. A client does nothing for any other value, nor where prop names no prop it holds.

0.name: animate
0.note: Play the animation name, with value as its flags, starting at first (match time in seconds) for second seconds; option nonzero removes the prop afterwards. effect and point have no effect.

1.name: linkEffect
1.note: Drive the prop's particle value effect from capture point point; a client refuses the change where option is not zero. name, first, second and value have no effect.

2.name: look
2.note: Change the prop's look to name, numbered value. The rest have no effect.

fields.name: option
fields.note: For animate, nonzero to remove the prop after the animation; for linkEffect, zero.

fields.name: effect
fields.note: For linkEffect, which of the prop's effect values to drive.

fields.name: point
fields.note: For linkEffect, which capture point drives it.

fields.name: name
fields.note: The name the change loads, such as a set of movements the prop plays. Written out in full and padded with zero bytes to the width above.

fields.name: startsAt
fields.note: When the change begins, in milliseconds of match time.

fields.name: lasts
fields.note: How long the change runs, in seconds.

fields.name: prop
fields.note: The prop changed, by the name MapProp gave it.

fields.name: flags
fields.note: How the change is made. The bits within are undetermined; a server sends 1 or 2.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What sort of change it is. A server sends 1; what other kinds carry is undetermined.
